upstream.description: Ingest, parse, and optimize any data format ➡️ from documents to multimedia ➡️ for enhanced compatibility with GenAI frameworks

classification.analysis: OmniParse is a self-hosted, GPU-based ingestion/parsing platform that converts documents (PDF, DOCX, PPTX), images, video, audio, and web pages into clean, structured markdown optimized for GenAI use cases like RAG and fine-tuning. It runs entirely locally (no external APIs, fits on a T4 GPU) using Surya OCR, Marker, Florence-2 for vision/captioning, and Whisper for audio/video transcription, exposed as a FastAPI server with a Gradio UI and Docker deployment. Aimed at developers building RAG pipelines or LLM data-prep workflows who want a single unified parsing API instead of stitching together separate OCR/transcription/crawling tools; last pushed December 2025 so development has gone quiet.

use_cases.title: Convert PDFs, PPTs, and Word docs into clean markdown for a RAG pipeline
Transcribe audio/video files locally with Whisper via an API
Self-host a unified ingestion API instead of combining separate OCR and crawler tools
Crawl and convert dynamic web pages to structured markdown
